name: emit nodes with no pending predecessors
mechanism: repeatedly emit a node whose predecessors have all been emitted, removing its outgoing edges, so the output respects every dependency; a cycle leaves nodes never emitted

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Topological sort' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Graph algorithms: finds linear order of nodes (e.g. jobs) based on their dependencies.

fails_when: cycles: some nodes are never emitted (detectable by count)
many valid orders; the tie-break is policy
